name: Oriole Orchards
description: Oriole Orchards grows Apples, Pears, Peaches, Nectarines, and Cherries in Red Hook, NY. The farm is small, and its seasons run through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
